newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hashimoto to meet ministers Tuesday evening.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto to meet ministers Tuesday evening.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will meet some cabinet members Tuesday evening upon his return from Singapore to discuss developments in Japan during his absence, government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama said on Tuesday.

Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka, Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda and Kajiyama will brief Hashimoto, among others, on developments in the Peru hostage crisis as well as the recent stock market moves, Kajiyama told a regular news conference.

Kajiyama also repeated his earlier remarks that there was no immediate remedy to effectively turn around the bearish stock market and repeated the government's commitment to carry out the financial and other reforms promised by Hashimoto.
Hashimoto, who returns from a eight-day tour of Southeast Asian nations, is expected to arrive at Haneda Airport after 9 p.m. (1200 GMT), Kajiyama said.
